verdict.rationale: Codex explicitly documents an MCP server mode (`codex mcp-server`) allowing an external MCP client to connect and control the local Codex engine, but this interface is labeled experimental and is now deprecated in favor of an unspecified 'Codex app server' replacement. Missing for 10: current (non-deprecated) documentation of the replacement server's MCP interface, independent/hands-on confirmation that external agents successfully connect via it, and clarity on feature parity after deprecation.
